_note: Hebrew -> LXX -> NT lexical bridge (review F2): one row per canon thread's key word, hand-seeded. `heb` are Strong's ids (the Hebrew books' lemma ids); `lxx` are lemma keys in the CenterBLC Rahlfs LXX, transliterated by the Greek scheme; `nt` are MorphGNT lemma keys (lang/greek.lemma_key). Each row cites one verse per corpus where the pairing can be seen; tests/test_bridge.py checks every cited word is really in that verse, when the corpora are on disk. A fuller table needs a licensed Hatch-Redpath-style dataset and is a later question.
